selected.paper: Romero SA et al. J Physiol 2016;594(17):5009-23, PMID 27061420 (update: PMID 29455450, J Physiol 2018;596(6):1103)
selected.evidence_basis: PubMed abstract only (no full text available) plus GEO series description
selected.assay: bulk RNA-seq, Illumina HiSeq 2500 (GPL16791), STAR 2.4.0i to GRCh38 / Ensembl 78, HTSeq-count 0.6.1
selected.samples: 48 = 16 subjects x 3 time points (pre, immediately after, 3 h after one 60-min bout of moderate single-leg knee-extension exercise); 8 control (no drug), 8 combined H1/H2 histamine-receptor blockade before exercise
selected.repeated_measure_unit: subject (3 biopsies per subject); drug is between-subject
selected.primary_estimand: Exercise effect on the muscle transcriptome over time within subjects (post vs pre), and the difference in that response between control and H1/H2 blockade (time x drug)
planned_contrasts: control: immediately post vs pre and 3 h post vs pre (abstract: exercise DE >3000 protein-coding genes; exact per-contrast split not in abstract)
control vs blockade post exercise (abstract: 795 genes differentially expressed between control and blockade)

paper_threshold.source_locator: abstract has no threshold; full text unavailable

selected.paper_method: not stated in abstract (GEO: STAR + HTSeq-count; DE tool not named)
selected.note: GEO overall_design: alignments re-run with updated software, updated DE tables and protein-coding counts deposited 2016-08-30 and reported in PMID 29455450; the abstract figures are from the original 2016 analysis

decisions.reason: Built from the PubMed abstract of PMID 27061420 (and its 2018 update notice) and the GEO series summary/overall_design. The abstract gives the two headline counts but no threshold, DE method, or per-timepoint split.

checks.metadata: GSE71972 SOFT lists 48 GSM samples matching the paper design (8 CON + 8 HIST subjects x pre/immediate/post); SOFT cites PMID 27061420 and 29455450
checks.matrix: no count matrix obtainable: series supplementary files (GSE71972_Protein_Coding_Full_Counts_Updated_20160830.xlsx, GSE71972_RAW.tar), per-sample *.counts.txt.gz and NCBI-generated counts all live on ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov, which returns HTTP 403 for every GEO path from this machine (also with sandbox disabled); SOFT carries no data tables (Sample_data_row_count = 0); not cached locally

decisions.reason: The metadata belong to the paper's accession and samples, but the expression matrix cannot be retrieved, so ownership of a matrix cannot be confirmed and no later gate (alignment, matrix type, design checks) can run. This is a missing-file block, not a scientific refusal: the design (16 subjects x 3 times, drug between subjects) supports the exercise contrasts once the counts are available. See download_attempts.txt.

details.stop_reason: Count matrix unavailable: GEO file host ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov returns HTTP 403 for all GSE71972 supplementary and sample files from this network; place GSE71972_Protein_Coding_Full_Counts_Updated_20160830.xlsx (or GSE71972_RAW.tar) in data/GSE71972/ and rerun.
